Kelly Smith Decision Coach · Creator of The Meek Method
About
You made the decision. So why does it keep reopening? Sometimes the hardest part isn't choosing. It's holding the choice when doubt, guilt, fear, responsibility, or someone else's reaction shows up. I'm Aimee Meek, Decision Coach and creator of The Meek Method. I help people separate pressure from new evidence, see what's pulling a decision back into question, and build enough stability to keep moving. At the center of my work is one question: "Did the information change, or did the pressure increase?" When you can tell the difference, you stop treating every wave of discomfort like proof that you chose wrong. HOW WE CAN WORK TOGETHER: • Decision & Action Intensives: focused 1:1 sessions for a choice or turning point that keeps reopening. • The Decision Pressure Lab: a structured group space to practice holding decisions in real time. • Private Decision Coaching: ongoing support for leaders, founders, and professionals working through complex transitions. RECENT CLIENT MOVEMENT: Clients have used this work to finish and publish books, clarify and launch new offers, step into senior leadership roles, and hold boundaries around career and life changes without sliding back into chronic second-guessing. If you're facing a decision that keeps reopening, or holding one you've already made, message me here on LinkedIn. The Decision Call link is in my Featured section below.
Fits the 2,600-character limit as-is.
FAQ

Good questions.

Is this really free?

Yes. No invoice, no catch. Think of it as a sample of my work — you keep everything either way.

Why me?

I rebuild LinkedIn profiles for coaches. Your work was one clear line away from a profile that sells it — so I wrote that line.

Can I edit your copy?

Please do. It's a starting point — your voice is the final judge.

What if I don't like it?

Keep the parts you like, skip the rest. No hard feelings — the files are still yours.

How do I get all this onto my profile?

Every section has a copy button — copy, paste into LinkedIn, done. Your banner and photo files arrive by email at full size, ready to upload.
